'''2020 TMW Pods Paul Coggins DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Paul Coggins]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

* '''Player:''' [[Paul Coggins]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
